title: I3S point cloud scene layer: defaultGeometrySchema

geometryType.description: The type of primitive. Only points are supported for point cloud scene layer. Must be: `points`

header.description: The header in binary buffers. Currently not supported for point cloud scene layer.

topology.description: This property is currently **ignored* for point cloud scene layer since it only contains geometry position without vertex attributes. Must be: `PerAttributeArray`

encoding.description: Only 'lepcc-xyz' compression is currently supported. Must be: `lepcc-xyz`

ordering.description: Currently the geometry contains XYZ only, so vertex attribute must only list 'position'. Possible values for each array string: `position`: vertex coordinates
